title: Cannot open PowerToys, after a flash white the app crashed

status.label: Needs focused diagnostics
status.detail: Original report includes screenshots and an older report archive; a later user describes a similar failure limited to opening Settings on newer versions.

next_action.label: Request current startup bug report
next_action.reason: Current version, failing surface, and fresh diagnostics will distinguish the launch path.

judgment.rationale: A recurring Settings/startup failure is plausible, but the latest comment describes a different version and possibly a different failing surface than the original report. The existing diagnostic archive predates that recurrence, so the failing component cannot be established.
evidence: Original reporter says PowerToys showed a white flash and disappeared; screenshots and a March 2024 report ZIP are attached.
Original reporter said reinstalling did not resolve the issue.
A separate October 2024 commenter reports a white box and crash when opening Settings on versions newer than 0.81.1, while shortcuts still work.
No linked fix PR was found in the issue timeline or PR search.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the latest stable release still reproduces, clarify whether the failure is at app startup or only when opening Settings, and collect a fresh /bugreport after reproduction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys Settings/startup crash is within product code, but the current evidence does not identify the failing component; retain a low-confidence hypothesis, not a confirmed cause.

proposed_fixes.title: Trace and repair the failing Settings startup path
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Red hypothesis: a failure during Settings UI initialization or launch causes the white window to exit before it becomes usable. The evidence does not distinguish persisted settings, UI initialization, or another startup dependency.
plan: Reproduce on a current build and correlate fresh diagnostics with the exact failing process and launch path.
Trace the first failing Settings initialization/launch step and fix only the confirmed branch.
Add focused regression coverage for the confirmed failure condition.
verification: Reproduce the confirmed path on current stable and verify the window remains usable.
Run affected Settings/startup tests and verify normal launch and shortcuts still work.

confidence.rationale: Two users describe related symptoms, but the failing surfaces differ and the attached archive predates the later recurrence.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys reportedly flashes a white window and exits; a later commenter reports a similar failure when opening Settings, but on newer versions and with shortcuts still working.
known_information: Original report identifies PowerToys 0.79.0, GitHub installation, white flash, screenshots, and a March 2024 report ZIP.
Original reporter says reinstalling did not help.
Separate October 2024 commenter reports Settings crashes on versions newer than 0.81.1 while shortcuts work.
inferences: The later report may be a Settings-only launch failure rather than full PowerToys startup failure.
The old archive cannot establish the cause of the later recurrence.
issue_context.analysis: The issue combines an original startup report with a later Settings-only report. Confirm current version and exact failing surface, then collect diagnostics for that occurrence before choosing a fix.
initial_investigation: Read full issue body, all comments, attachment references, current labels, assignees, and updatedAt.
Reviewed suggested similar issue 32000; it is closed and its reporter said reinstalling resolved it.
Searched related PowerToys PRs by issue number; no linked fix found.

information_gaps.why_needed: The original 0.79.0 and later Settings-only report may be different failures.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Check About if available, identify installed version otherwise, and state which launch action fails.

information_gaps.information: Current diagnostics captured immediately after reproducing the later failure.
information_gaps.why_needed: The March archive predates the later recurrence and cannot identify that process or exception.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce and comment /bugreport immediately afterward. If Settings and tray cannot open, run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys installation directory.

comment.body:
Thanks for the original screenshots and March 2024 PowerToysReport attachment, and for noting reinstalling did not help. The October 2024 comment describes a similar white box when opening Settings on newer versions, but it does not say whether PowerToys itself exits or only Settings; the attachment predates the later occurrence.
Please provide:
1. Whether the latest stable build still reproduces, and whether failure occurs at PowerToys startup or only when opening Settings.
2. If it persists, reproduce and comment /bugreport immediately afterward. If Settings and tray cannot open, run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys installation directory.
These details will identify the failing launch path and provide current evidence.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Approve an evidence-gated fork-side investigation; first confirm the current failure path, then design only the confirmed fix. This does not write upstream.
